title: Press freedom under Chinese scrutiny in Denmark | RSF
body: Mar 16, 2026 · After reporting on China’s military parade and Beijing’s efforts to influence Western narratives about Taiwan, Danish newspaper Berlingske was the object of letters, a press release and social media posts by the Chinese embassy in Copenhagen that scrutinised and attempted to discredit its work.

title: Proposed Danish Media Ombudsperson Threatens Press Freedom
body: Sep 17, 2025 · Prepared by Flutura Kusari and Mogens Blicher Bjerregård. On 28 January 2025, the Danish Media Liability Committee published a report aiming to strengthen legal protections of its citizens in the digital age.

title: Growing challenges to Danish press freedom | Reuters ...
body: In a new Journalist Fellow paper, James Miles, from Danish newspaper Ekstra Bladet, outlines how Denmark, widely regarded as one the best places in the world for press freedom, has seen a steady erosion in the freedom of the journalists to scrutinise the actions of their government.

title: Denmark - Centre for Media Pluralism and Media Freedom
body: Denmark maintains a strong media pluralism framework, but concerns remain regarding free speech restrictions, market concentration, and media viability challenges in the case of regional and local media.

title: Denmark
body: The 2022 election led to the first majority government in decades, comprising parties from both the right and left. According to Eurobarometer, support for and satisfaction with democracy in Denmark is number one in Europe. Denmark was also rated highly in the University of Gothenburg V-Dem Institute’s global ranking of democracies in 2025.
